Kwame, the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to you was **November 3, 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest from 11/2 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's Dec 8 cutover recap also gives Nov 3 as the official handoff.

Bettina kept running PHL day to day through Nov 21 to finish the terminal cutover. Per her recap, you fully took over operations on Nov 22. For the CRM, Nov 3 is the ownership date. If it has a field for when you started working the account day to day, use Nov 22.
